narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Four arms always give four angles of symmetry, whatever the angles between them.
<bookmark mark='look'/>Turn the red arm onto the next arm, which is seventy degrees away.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The other arms move seventy degrees too, but the next gap is one hundred ten, so they miss.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Equal arms need equal gaps, or a turn cannot move every arm onto the next.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Four identical arms have gaps of fifty, one hundred thirty, fifty and one hundred thirty degrees. Does a turn of fifty degrees fit?
